title: Webhook Delivery Timeouts for Slow Endpoints
customerImpact: Webhook deliveries to endpoints responding slower than 10 seconds were dropped after retry exhaustion. 0.02% of webhook deliveries affected. No API ingest impact.
investigation: Webhook retry queue grew as the delivery worker pool stalled on long-running HTTP connections.
rootCause: The webhook delivery client had no per-request timeout, so a handful of slow endpoints occupied worker threads indefinitely.
mitigation: Deployed a per-request timeout of 15s, connection pooling limits, and faster failure classification. Released stalled workers immediately.
monitoring: Delivery latency and retry queue depth monitored for 90 minutes.
resolution: Webhook delivery latency normalized. All retryable webhooks were re-delivered.
